basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new production concept turnaround SHEET of a freestanding PAPER ALLEY BACKDROP WALL, not a booth or building. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only: ornate layered paper carnival walls behind the stalls, plus a matching wall turnaround example. Match its physical cut-paper relief, worn painted timber-paper, brass fretwork and Victorian sideshow elegance. Subject: {name}. Palette and ornament: {theme}. Secrets: {secret}; all closed decorative future entrances. Wall about 5m wide x 4m high x .3m thin; curved stepped ornate silhouette, modest tall side pinnacles, believable layered thickness. Design both front and finished back; reverse shows simpler matching ornament and corresponding door back, not a new unrelated design. FOUR views of SAME wall in equal 2x2 quadrants: upper-left FRONT elevation; upper-right BACK elevation; lower-left LEFT three-quarter showing thin edge; lower-right RIGHT three-quarter showing thin edge. Front/back truly straight-on, entire silhouettes visible with clear margins inside quadrants; equal groundline per row, blank separation at image centre. Cream studio background. No stall, vendor, people, attraction apparatus, furniture, surrounding scene, floor, labels, text, grid lines, or watermark. The subject is only a scenery wall to sit BEHIND a separate existing stall. Rich layered papercraft, not flat icons, no modern cartoon gradients.

assets.promptOverride: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW game-environment asset using attached image ONLY as art-direction reference, not an edit of that sheet. Deliver one turnaround sheet for the MATCHING PAPER ALLEY BACKDROP WALL behind Mystic Tent/Iris. No stall, no vendor, no character, no telescope, no booth furniture. The subject is just a freestanding modular scenery wall with layered cut-paper Gothic curves, deep plum timber-paper panels, tiny gilt moon/star reliefs, warm brass edging. A narrow locked moon door on the front and a concealed little tunnel hatch, both closed. Finished back decorated more simply in matching plum/brass, not an unfinished cardboard back. Visible thick stacked paper edges. This is a wall, about 5 metres wide and 4 metres high, only .3 metre thick. Four views of THE EXACT SAME WALL on one landscape turnaround sheet, arranged 2x2: top-left straight FRONT, top-right straight BACK, bottom-left LEFT edge at slight three-quarter angle, bottom-right RIGHT edge at slight three-quarter angle. All views wholly inside their quadrants with generous clear margin, equal vertical scale, aligned ground lines per row. No perspective on front/back. Show thin side thickness honestly, not four different buildings. Pure cream background, no ground scenery, no cast shadows outside silhouettes, no text/captions/borders/watermarks. Rich detailed physical papercraft like the reference, not flat vector. These walls are separate scenery to place behind existing booths. Save the generated image as a real file and return its location.
